name: The Borrower
summary: Daryn Lightwind is fascinated by the snapjaws on the beach in the Hinterlands, and above all by a giant one named Gammerita. Her research keeps her where she is, so she gives you a letter to carry to Curgle Cranklehop in Tanaris.

sections.title: A Picture of Gammerita
sections.body: Daryn Lightwind says she has studied many subjects, and her latest fascination is the snapjaws that live along the beach in the Hinterlands. One she especially wants to see is a giant snapjaw called Gammerita. She would go herself, but her research keeps her here, so a picture of Gammerita would be the next best thing.

sections.title: The Letter to Tanaris
sections.body: Daryn hands you a letter for Curgle Cranklehop in Tanaris. Curgle has made an invention for Daryn that can capture a picture, which Daryn believes Curgle calls a snapshot.

sections.title: Curgle's Reaction
sections.body: Curgle takes you for one of Daryn's interns and speaks well of Daryn as a knowledgeable historian. Then Curgle goes off to fetch the Super Snapper FX, certain you will love it.

faq.answer: Daryn Lightwind, who gives you a letter to carry. Her research keeps her from going herself.
Someone in Tanaris who has made an invention for Daryn that can capture a picture, which Daryn believes is called a snapshot.

faq.q: Why does Daryn want a picture of Gammerita?
faq.answer: Daryn is fascinated by the snapjaws along the Hinterlands beach, and wants to see Gammerita in particular. Research keeps Daryn from going, so a picture is the next best thing.
A giant snapjaw on the beach in the Hinterlands.
